description: Active Disturbance Rejection Controller for a first-order plant (PMSM dq current). ESO + state-feedback combination: a linear extended-state observer with the pole-pair gain family (OmegaL, ObsDamp: beta1 = 2*zeta*wl, beta2 = wl^2) estimates the total disturbance, and a B0-lifted control law u = (u0 - z2)/B0 cancels it. Unlike Control.Ladrc the ESO disturbance estimate is exposed as first-class outputs (DistRate/DistVolts) for wiring to telemetry.

outputPorts.name: DistVolts
outputPorts.description: Estimated total disturbance expressed in control-effort units (z2/B0; volts for current-loop use): the equivalent input the ESO cancels. For a PMSM q axis at steady state this is -(Rs*Iq + we*(Lambda + Ld*Id)).

outputPorts.name: DistRate
outputPorts.description: Estimated total disturbance rate (ESO state z2, A/s for current-loop use): everything di/dt sees besides B0*u.

outputPorts.name: EstState
outputPorts.description: Estimated process output (ESO state z1, A): the observer's filtered current estimate.

B0.description: Plant gain estimate b0. For dq current use ≈ 1/L (e.g. Ld or Lq).

OmegaC.description: Controller bandwidth ωc [rad/s]. u0 = ωc·(Setpoint − z1).

OmegaL.description: Observer pole family bandwidth ωl [rad/s]. β1 = 2·ObsDamp·ωl, β2 = ωl². Typically 3–10× ωc.

ObsDamp.description: Observer pole-pair damping ζ (dimensionless). ζ = 1 gives the critically damped double pole at −ωl (the Control.Ladrc gain family); 0.7 (Butterworth) trades peaking for a rounder disturbance-estimate transient.

Z2.description: Persistent ESO state: estimated total disturbance.

UPrev.description: Persistent previous control effort for the ESO input.

OutputMax.description: Upper output clamp (also limited by Vdc/√3·0.95).
